 ← Blog November 6, 2026 · updated November 14, 2026 · guides · coding agents · setup
 How to use uncensored models in Cursor, Cline, Codex, OpenCode and Claude Code
 Point any coding tool at uncensored models: base URL, key and model id for Cline, Kilo, Roo, Cursor, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Claude Code (native, no proxy), and the OpenAI SDK.
 OpenUncensored is an OpenAI compatible API, so any tool that lets you set a custom OpenAI base URL can use its
82 uncensored models (61 text and 21 image). You need two things:
 Base URL: https://api.openuncensored.com/v1
 API key: an ou- key from openuncensored.com/credits . No account, no sign up.
 Pick a model id from the rankings or GET https://api.openuncensored.com/v1/models . For agent and coding work,
start with deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored : it is at the top of the rankings, fast, and cheap on long agent sessions because most of
each request is served from the prompt cache.
 Let your agent set it up
 The fastest way: paste this into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode

observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && for u in "https://openuncensored.com/rankings" "https://openuncensored.com" "https://openuncensored.com/blog/use-uncensored-models-in-cursor-cline-codex"; do echo "########## $u"; curl -s --max-time 25 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "$u" | python3 -c "
import sys,re,html
s=sys.stdin.read()
s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); s=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',s,flags=re.S)
s=re.sub(r'<(br|/p|/div|/li|/h[1-6]|/tr)>','\n',s)
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s)); t=re.sub(r'[ \t]+',' ',t); t=re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+','\n',t)
print(t[:1200])
"; done
